description: Generate studio-grade music (MP3) in any style from a natural language prompt with Eleven Music — vocals or instrumental, commercial-use cleared.
summary: Text-to-music: describe genre, mood, instrumentation and vocals, set music_length_ms (3s–120s, required — it is the billing basis). Output is MP3 base64 (audio_base64). Priced $0.15 per minute of generated music, prorated per second. Generation takes up to a few minutes — this endpoint has an extended timeout.

prompt.description: Describe the music: genre, mood, instrumentation, vocals, structure (e.g. 'Uplifting acoustic folk with warm male vocals, gentle guitar and hand claps').
examples: Energetic synthwave with driving bass, retro drums and a soaring lead melody, instrumental

music_length_ms.description: Length of the generated track in milliseconds (3000–300000). REQUIRED — it is the exact billing basis ($0.15 per minute, prorated per second).

model_id.description: Music model: music_v1 (default) or music_v2 (better prompt adherence, multilingual vocals, mid-track transitions).

body.description: Generate a music track from a text prompt

variants.label: Music v1 — per minute of generated audio
Music v2 — per minute of generated audio

notes: Generated audio is saved on Monid cloud with a default 7-day retention; the run output carries an `audio` object with a fresh signed download_link (valid ~1h — re-fetch the run for a new one), content_type and link/file expiries. To keep the file past retention, download it via the link and re-upload with the sfs /put endpoint; after retention the object reads { expired: true }. audio_base64 appears inline only if the save failed.

music_length_ms is REQUIRED and billed exactly; the Monid cap is 300000ms — a PAYLOAD-size product cap, not the upstream limit. KNOWN RISK: tracks near the cap can exceed the run-payload bound and fail the run.
Output is MP3 44.1kHz 128kbps, returned base64-encoded in the run output (audio_base64).
Composition plans, inpainting and seeds are out of scope — prompt-mode generation only.
